handoff.description: Save the current session to a memory file
handoff.template: Call the `handoff` tool with a short note describing the current task. Then tell me the memory file path and that I can start a new session to continue.

resume.description: Continue from the latest handoff memory
resume.template: Read the file ~/.config/opencode/memory/latest-handoff.md and continue the work described there. First summarize what was in progress and what the next step is.
